text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way home, Mihono Bourbon says that she wants to run in even bigger races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has never been able to express her emotions well, nor is she one to assert herself…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now, she appears to have found the pleasure in racing after her many encounters with her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, who has also greatly improved, challenges Mihono Bourbon to a rematch at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It'll be a grand race with Rice Shower, Mejiro McQueen, and Tokai Teio. Mihono Bourbon's eyes glint with excitement at the prospect.
